from_speaker: Microsoft spent more than $260 billion on capex
less than $11 billion in annual revenue outside of OpenAI
our_interpretation: Assess the financial assertions, excluding the judgment that they constitute an objective disaster.
Read annual revenue as revenue actually earned over a year, rather than a current revenue rate multiplied by twelve.
Use the fiscal year ending June 30, 2026, the latest completed annual reporting period before the post, for the revenue assertion.
The cumulative capex assertion has no stated starting date. Do not invent one or assume all Microsoft capex served AI.
The metric_scope describes the annual revenue component. The cumulative expenditure component requires a separate reconciliation.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records establish both cumulative expenditure above $260 billion attributable to creating this AI business and realized annual AI revenue excluding OpenAI below $11 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish annual AI revenue excluding OpenAI of at least $11 billion, or establish cumulative expenditure of at most $260 billion over the intended accumulation period.
